quote.text: In every walk with nature, one receives far more than he seeks.
quote.author: John Muir

fun_fact.text: Hungary is home to over 1,500 natural thermal springs, more than any other country in the world! The tradition of thermal bathing in Hungary dates back over 2,000 years to Roman times, and Budapest is the only capital city with healing thermal springs.

short_read.title: The Secret Language of Trees
short_read.teaser: Scientists have discovered that trees communicate with each other through an underground network of fungi, sharing nutrients and warning signals. This 'Wood Wide Web' shows that forests are communities, not just collections of individual trees.

medium_read.title: The Return of Sea Otters to the Pacific Northwest
medium_read.teaser: Once hunted nearly to extinction, sea otters are making a remarkable comeback along the Pacific coast. These playful marine mammals are not just adorable—they're essential to keeping kelp forests healthy and thriving.

long_read.title: The Beauty and History of Hungary's Tokaj Wine Region
long_read.teaser: For centuries, Hungary's Tokaj region has produced some of the world's most prized sweet wines, favored by kings and emperors. This journey through the vineyards explores the landscape, traditions, and remarkable winemaking heritage that earned Tokaj UNESCO World Heritage status.

port_angeles.title: Black-Tailed Deer Season in Port Angeles
port_angeles.description: August is a wonderful time to spot black-tailed deer around Port Angeles, especially in the early morning and evening hours. These gentle creatures are often seen grazing near the edges of forests and meadows, and their fawns are losing their spots as they grow. Keep an eye out during walks around Park View Villas!

puzzle_1.question: A hummingbird's heart beats approximately ___ times per minute during flight.
puzzle_1.correct_response: Exactly right! That's an incredibly fast heartbeat—about 20 times per second!
puzzle_1.close_response: You're very close! A hummingbird's heart beats about 1,200 times per minute while flying.
puzzle_1.wrong_response: Those tiny hearts work incredibly hard! A hummingbird's heart beats about 1,200 times per minute during flight—that's roughly 20 beats every second!
puzzle_1.learn_more_text: Hummingbirds have the fastest metabolism of any animal on Earth. To fuel their high-energy lifestyle, they must consume about half their body weight in nectar each day and visit hundreds of flowers.

puzzle_2.question: Which Hungarian word means 'butterfly'?
puzzle_2.correct_response: Wonderful! Pillangó is indeed Hungarian for butterfly—such a beautiful, musical word!
puzzle_2.wrong_response: The Hungarian word for butterfly is 'pillangó'—doesn't it sound lovely? (Virág means flower, madár means bird, and méhecske means little bee.)
puzzle_2.learn_more_text: Hungarian is a unique language that belongs to the Finno-Ugric family, making it quite different from neighboring European languages. It's known for its beautiful, flowing sound and expressive vocabulary.

puzzle_3.question: What ocean animal holds hands with its partner while sleeping to avoid drifting apart?
puzzle_3.correct_response: That's right! Sea otters hold hands while they sleep—one of nature's most heartwarming behaviors. They also wrap themselves in kelp to stay anchored!
puzzle_3.wrong_response: It's sea otters! These adorable creatures hold hands while sleeping so they don't drift apart from each other. They sometimes also wrap themselves in kelp forests to stay in place.
puzzle_3.learn_more_text: Sea otters are among the smallest marine mammals but have the densest fur of any animal—up to one million hairs per square inch! This thick fur keeps them warm in the cold Pacific waters.
